images.title: Graveside listener
images.intent: A quiet conversation with an uncertain shade builds on the loved necromancy and communal rites.
images.boundary: Tests an intimate spirit encounter; neither the nature of souls nor an afterlife is established.
images.brief: A mature human woman about 52 with a long crooked nose, soft heavy eyelids, tied dark-gray hair and a thoughtful, rather kind face, in a plain dark plum wool coat and slate skirt, kneels beside an empty low stone seat in a sparse burial courtyard. She holds no casting device and is gently speaking, palms resting naturally on her knees. On the seat is a faint incomplete elderly human silhouette, made of soft gray translucent shadow, concentrated around bowed shoulders and a suggested profile; the ground remains visible through it. No skeleton costume, gore, skull jewelry, chains, light strings or spectral beam. A humble sprig laid at the seat and worn stone establish attention and care. The scene feels like patient listening, not a theatrical summoning. Late warm daylight touches the listener while the shade remains cool. Right details: her individual face; her ordinary hands and the boundary where the faint shade meets the seat.

images.title: Boilerhouse thaumaturge
images.intent: A scholarly worker supplies heat to a substantial working boiler.
images.boundary: Tests one meeting of magic and steam, not a mandatory caster powering every machine.
images.brief: A broad-shouldered human woman around 55, olive skin, cropped silver hair, expressive heavy brows and a capable lined face. She wears a practical blue-gray wool work coat, plain linen sleeves and one insulated glove. She tends a roughly three-meter iron steam boiler with riveted seams, copper supply pipe, readable pressure gauge, a safety valve and masonry footing. Its open firebox contains a concentrated blue-white magical heat held low in the refractory chamber; her ungloved hand is near the opening in focused concentration, with no beam connecting it. Natural white steam escapes a valve; pipes lead sensibly out of the vignette toward work elsewhere. Large useful industrial craft, no decorative gear clusters, lens apparatus or giant crystal core. Main scene shows her whole body and a coherent compact boiler layout. Right details: the firebox and hand; functioning valve, iron seam and copper fitting. Warm brick, dark iron, cool scholarly blue, controlled industrial power.

images.title: Lockyard tug
images.intent: A small steam tug tests heavier practical technology on ordinary waterways.
images.boundary: It floats by its hull in water; this explores technology level without bringing back mechanical flight.
images.brief: A compact eight-meter steam tug maneuvering beside an old masonry canal lock, seen in clear three-quarter view with its entire sturdy timber-and-iron hull visible in WATER. Two small side paddle housings, a squat riveted boiler, short smoke stack, plain wheel station and sensible deck rails. One middle-aged human pilot in ordinary canvas coat and cap stands at the wheel; a second human deckhand handles a tow rope leading to a partially visible work barge. Real coiled rope and functional fittings, a modest amount of steam and a dark puff of smoke, no magical energy strings. Worn dark green painted panels, copper and brown timber, a sturdy original high-fantasy steam craft with useful proportions. Water curls against the bow and paddle wake brings motion. Absolutely no hovering, aerial balloons, wings, futuristic cockpit, decorative clock face or random cog ornament. Right studies: boiler/valve assembly; a section of hull and paddle mechanics above the waterline. This is a larger technological edge test.

images.title: Underbridge vaporwright
images.intent: A vivid urban alchemist brings direct magic into a rough working environment.
images.boundary: Tests bolder color, character and magical chemistry; no mandatory equipment system.
images.brief: An adult male goblin alchemist with a long broad nose, huge uneven ears, olive-brown skin, small heavy-lidded eyes, stubble-like painted chin shadow and thinning dark hair. Wiry mature build, not a child or cute mascot. A single thick patched burgundy apron over a slate shirt and rolled trousers, one sensible pouch. He bends over a small scarred worktable under an old urban brick arch, intently shaping a dense violet vapor above a concave copper vessel with the poised fingers of one bare hand. A flask of vivid chartreuse liquid catches warm light beside it; modest chemistry tools, clay sink and one pipe give industrial texture without a clutter wall. The vapor briefly forms a crisp faceted shape like a mineral flower before softening, no magical strings, gadget glove or floating equations. Strong diagonal composition, intimate face, sour-green/violet accents balanced with dirty warm brick. Right details: specific goblin face; hand, vapor and vessel. Clever, slightly dangerous, resourceful urban fantasy.
